concept: Auto Scaling: target tracking on average CPU
tests: Choosing a scaling policy for unpredictable spikes that keeps average CPU near a target.
expected: ASG with a target tracking policy (ASGAverageCPUUtilization = 50%). Triggers: "unpredictable traffic spikes", "maintain average CPU near 50%".
why_not: Scheduled scaling — only for predictable patterns; manual scaling does not react in time; one large instance — no elasticity or HA.
